caseTitle.zh: 緩和門診：先問會不會斷
caseTitle.en: Palliative clinic: will it break first?

condition.zh: 緩和放療 · 骨轉移與再照射
condition.en: Palliative RT · bone metastasis and re-irradiation

title.zh: 放射腫瘤科：緩和放療門診日
title.en: Radiation oncology: a palliative clinic day

tagline.zh: 從一根會痛的大腿骨到一條記得劑量的脊髓
tagline.en: From a femur that hurts to a spinal cord that remembers its dose

desc.zh: 問疼痛也問骨折風險、讀影像、讀 DVH、向骨科轉診、向病人解釋為什麼今天不能馬上照。
desc.en: Ask about pain and about fracture risk, read the images, read the DVH, refer to orthopaedics, and explain to a patient why she cannot simply be treated today.

desc.zh: 勾畫、排計畫、把兩張 DVH 放在一起看、送獨立檢核、提醒醫師器官記得以前的劑量。計畫室的最後一雙眼睛是你。
desc.en: Contour, build the plan, lay two DVHs side by side, send for the independent check, remind the doctor that organs remember old doses. You are the planning room's last pair of eyes.

about.zh: 放腫科主治，緩和門診的常客。第一句話永遠是「先問會不會斷，再問痛不痛」。辦公桌抽屜裡有一疊給病人的手繪骨頭圖。
about.en: Radiation oncologist and a fixture of the palliative clinic. Opens with 'ask if it will break before you ask if it hurts'. Keeps a drawer of hand-drawn bone diagrams for patients.

about.zh: 計畫室的劑量師，螢幕永遠開兩個視窗：一個是今天的計畫，一個是病人以前照過的劑量。口頭禪：「組織會記得。」
about.en: The planning-room dosimetrist with two windows always open: today's plan and every dose the patient has ever had. Catchphrase: 'Tissue remembers.'

about.zh: 獨立檢核的人。她不看計畫師怎麼算，自己再算一次。發現不一致的時候很開心，因為那代表系統在運作。
about.en: The independent checker. She does not look at how the planner worked it out; she works it out again. Discrepancies make her happy, because they mean the system is working.

role.zh: 乳癌骨轉移 · 右髖痛
role.en: Breast cancer, bone metastases · right-hip pain

about.zh: 70 歲，乳癌骨轉移，右髖痛一個月，走路要扶牆。下週孫子大學畢業典禮，她想「照一照止痛，走進禮堂」。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 70-year-old with breast cancer and bone metastases, a month of right-hip pain, walking along the wall. Her grandson graduates next week and she wants 'a quick zap for the pain so I can walk into the hall'. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 62 歲，肺癌，兩年前胸部照過一個療程。現在胸椎一節轉移很痛，靠近以前的照野。他問：「以前照過，再照會不會怎樣？」（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 62-year-old with lung cancer who had a course of chest radiotherapy two years ago. Now a painful thoracic metastasis sits close to the old field. He asks: 'It has been irradiated before; what happens if you do it again?' (Fictional.)

role.zh: 鼻咽癌 · 同步化放療中

about.zh: 48 歲，鼻咽癌同步化放療第四週，口腔黏膜炎，吃不下。今天照完治療覺得冷，想「回家睡一覺就好」。（虛擬個案）
about.en: A 48-year-old in week four of chemoradiation for nasopharyngeal cancer, with mucositis and barely eating. Felt cold after today's treatment and wants to 'go home and sleep it off'. (Fictional.)

about.zh: 治療室的放射治療師。病人一躺上治療床，她就知道今天哪裡不一樣。
about.en: The radiation therapist in the treatment room. The moment a patient lies on the couch she knows what is different today.

about.zh: 骨科住院醫師。你說「大腿骨轉移、皮質被吃掉、走路會痛」，他就知道要先固定。
about.en: The orthopaedic resident. Say 'femoral metastasis, cortex eaten away, pain on walking' and he knows fixation comes first.

plain.zh: 目的不是治癒，是減輕症狀：止痛、止血、解除壓迫。療程短、次數少，但每一步的核對和根治療程一樣多。
plain.en: Radiotherapy whose aim is relief rather than cure: pain, bleeding, pressure. Short courses, few sessions, and every check the same as for a curative one.

plain.zh: 被腫瘤侵蝕變弱的骨頭，在平常不會斷的力量下斷掉。大腿骨斷了，人就下不了床。
plain.en: A bone weakened by tumour breaking under a force that would not break a healthy one. When a femur goes, the person does not get out of bed.

plain.zh: 骨頭還沒斷之前，先用骨科的釘子或鋼板把它撐住。先固定再放療，比斷了再修容易得多。
plain.en: An orthopaedic nail or plate placed before the bone breaks. Fix first, irradiate after; far easier than repairing a break.

plain.zh: 骨頭外層最硬的那一圈。影像上皮質被吃掉越多，骨頭越容易斷。
plain.en: The hard outer shell of a bone. The more of it the image shows eaten away, the more likely the bone is to break.

plain.zh: 把身體的重量壓在那條腿上。大腿骨有高風險病灶時，先不承重、用拐杖，等骨科決定。
plain.en: Putting the body's weight through that leg. With a high-risk femoral lesion: no weight-bearing, crutches, until orthopaedics decides.

plain.zh: 一張圖，橫軸是劑量、縱軸是體積，告訴你每個器官有多少比例吃到多少劑量。它不告訴你劑量落在器官的哪個位置。
plain.en: A graph with dose along the bottom and volume up the side, showing what share of each organ receives how much dose. It does not say where in the organ that dose lands.

plain.zh: 同一個區域第二次放射治療。正常組織記得以前的劑量，所以要把舊計畫找出來，把兩次加在一起算。
plain.en: A second course of radiotherapy to the same area. Normal tissue remembers the earlier dose, so the old plan is retrieved and the two courses are added together.

plain.zh: 一個正常器官在可接受的風險下能承受的劑量。脊髓的耐受很有限，超過了可能癱瘓，所以每次計畫都要替它留餘地。
plain.en: The dose a normal organ can take at an acceptable risk. The spinal cord's tolerance is limited and exceeding it can paralyse, so every plan leaves it a margin.

plain.zh: 影像上看得到的腫瘤，加上看不到但可能藏著腫瘤的一圈。勾畫得太小會漏，太大會傷到旁邊的器官。
plain.en: The visible tumour plus a rim where invisible tumour may hide. Too small misses disease; too large injures the organs beside it.

plain.zh: 另一個人用另一種方法，不看原本的計算，自己再算一次。目的不是抓人，是抓錯。
plain.en: A second person recalculates by a different method without looking at the first. The aim is to catch errors, not people.

plain.zh: 緩和放療後頭幾天，痛可能先變厲害再變好。事先講清楚，病人就不會以為是惡化。
plain.en: In the first days after palliative radiotherapy the pain may worsen before it eases. Explained in advance, patients do not mistake it for progression.

plain.zh: 化療和放療同一段時間一起做。效果加成，副作用也加成：黏膜炎、吃不下、白血球下降。
plain.en: Chemotherapy and radiotherapy given over the same weeks. The effects add up, and so do the side effects: mucositis, poor intake, falling white cells.

plain.zh: 化療讓白血球很低的時候發燒。身體沒有兵，小感染幾小時內會變敗血症。不能「回家睡一覺」。
plain.en: A fever while the white cells are low from chemotherapy. With no defenders a small infection becomes sepsis in hours. Nobody 'sleeps it off'.

plain.zh: 治療前先用電腦斷層把病人固定好、做記號，之後每一次治療都照這個姿勢重現。
plain.en: The CT session before treatment where the patient is positioned, immobilised and marked, so that every treatment reproduces the same set-up.

text.zh: 阿倫的兩個視窗：今天的計畫、以前的劑量。再照射的病人，舊計畫要先融合進來，兩次加總看脊髓。
text.en: Lun's two windows: today's plan, yesterday's doses. For re-irradiation the old plan is fused in first and the two courses summed over the cord.

text.zh: 緩和門診的片子先看三樣：病灶在哪、骨皮質被吃掉多少、承重的骨頭還剩多少。痛不痛放第四。
text.en: In the palliative clinic an image is read for three things first: where the lesion is, how much cortex is gone, how much weight-bearing bone remains. Pain comes fourth.

text.zh: 吳阿姨躺在這裡被輕輕轉動右腿。轉動會痛、承重會痛，加上影像，骨折風險就有答案了。
text.en: Mrs Wu lies here while her right leg is gently rotated. Pain on rotation, pain on weight-bearing, plus the image: the fracture risk has its answer.

text.zh: 門診很少用到它。用到的那一次，通常是同步化放療的病人說「我只是有點冷」。
text.en: Rarely used in clinic. The time it is used is usually when a chemoradiation patient says 'I am just a little cold'.

text.zh: 一張 A5，畫著大腿骨，上面塗黑的一塊是病灶，旁邊寫「先撐住，再照」。吳阿姨把它折好放進包包，說要帶去畢業典禮。
text.en: An A5 sheet with a femur drawn on it, the lesion shaded in and 'prop it up first, then irradiate' beside it. Mrs Wu folds it into her bag to take to the graduation.

name.zh: 先問會不會斷，再問痛不痛
name.en: Will it break, before does it hurt

text.zh: 承重骨的轉移，放療能止痛，但止不了斷。病灶在大腿骨近端、骨皮質被吃掉一大段、走路就痛，三個合在一起是高風險。先轉骨科評估預防性固定，先不承重、拿拐杖，放療排在固定之後或之前，由兩科一起決定。止了痛、斷了骨，是緩和門診最常見的悔恨。
text.en: For a metastasis in a weight-bearing bone, radiotherapy relieves pain but does not prevent a break. A lesion in the proximal femur, a long stretch of cortex destroyed, pain on walking: together that is high risk. Refer to orthopaedics for prophylactic fixation, no weight-bearing, crutches, and schedule the radiotherapy around the fixation by joint decision. Pain relieved and bone broken is the palliative clinic's commonest regret.

text.zh: 再照射的第一步不是畫新計畫，是找出舊計畫。脊髓、食道、肺以前吃過多少，要融合、加總、再對照耐受。DVH 告訴你多少體積吃到多少，不告訴你熱點落在哪一節，所以要回到影像一層一層看。靶區和器官要一起看，不是先畫靶區再想辦法。
text.en: The first step of re-irradiation is not drawing the new plan but retrieving the old one. What the cord, oesophagus and lung received before is fused, summed and compared with tolerance. The DVH says how much volume receives how much dose, not at which level the hot spot sits, so you go back to the images slice by slice. Target and organs are looked at together, not target first and problems later.

name.zh: 疼痛暫時加劇不是惡化
name.en: A pain flare is not progression

text.zh: 緩和放療後頭幾天痛變厲害是常見的暫時現象。治療前講清楚、依醫囑備好止痛、留下聯絡電話，病人半夜打來的時候才不會以為自己完了。但新的無力、麻、大小便改變，就不是閃燃，要立刻回診。
text.en: Worse pain in the first days after palliative radiotherapy is a common, temporary phenomenon. Explain it beforehand, have analgesia ready per orders and leave a phone number, so the patient who calls at midnight does not believe it is the end. New weakness, numbness or bladder or bowel change, however, is not a flare and means come back at once.

note.zh: 今天：一根大腿骨、一條脊髓
note.en: Today: a femur and a spinal cord

guide.en: Hear today's list at the board

lines.zh: 緩和門診三個：吳阿姨，乳癌骨轉移，右髖痛，想今天照。賴先生，胸椎轉移，兩年前照過，再照射。小玉，鼻咽癌同步化放療第四週。
lines.en: Three in the palliative clinic: Mrs Wu, breast cancer with bone metastases, right-hip pain, wants treatment today. Mr Lai, thoracic metastasis, chest irradiated two years ago, re-irradiation. Yu, week four of concurrent chemoradiation for nasopharyngeal cancer.

lines.zh: 吳阿姨那一行，你們先問哪一個問題？
lines.en: Mrs Wu's line: which question do you ask first?

lines.zh: ……痛多久、多痛？
lines.en: ...How long, and how bad?

lines.zh: 錯。先問會不會斷，再問痛不痛。把緩和放療的流程排給我看，骨折風險評估要在哪一步。
lines.en: Wrong. Ask whether it will break before you ask whether it hurts. Lay out the palliative pathway for me, and show me where fracture risk belongs.

q.zh: 把緩和放射治療的流程排對
q.en: Put the palliative radiotherapy pathway in order

post.zh: 骨折風險在第二步，在模擬定位之前。順序對了，吳阿姨今天可能照不成，但下週她還走得進禮堂。
post.en: Fracture risk is step two, before simulation. In that order Mrs Wu may not be treated today, but next week she still walks into the hall.

guide.zh: 跟柳物理師談獨立檢核
guide.en: Talk to Dr Liu about the independent check

lines.zh: 昨天你送來的計畫，我算出來和你差了一點。不是誰算錯，是我們要一起找出為什麼。你知道獨立檢核是為了什麼嗎？
lines.en: The plan you sent yesterday: my figure differs slightly from yours. Nobody is 'wrong' yet; we find out why together. Do you know what the independent check is for?

post.zh: 對。它不是在看你有沒有錯，是在看系統有沒有漏。差異找到了：密度表版本不同。記錄、修正、通知。
post.en: Right. It is not watching for your mistakes; it is watching for gaps in the system. Found it: a different version of the density table. Record, correct, inform.

note.en: Mrs Wu: high risk, orthopaedics first

lines.zh: 醫師，右邊屁股到大腿痛一個月了，走路要扶牆。下禮拜孫子畢業典禮，照一照止痛就好，我要自己走進去。
lines.en: Doctor, from my right hip down the thigh, a month now, I walk along the wall. My grandson graduates next week; just zap it for the pain, I want to walk in on my own.

lines.zh: 吳阿姨，站著的時候痛，還是躺著也痛？晚上會不會痛醒？
lines.en: Mrs Wu, does it hurt when you stand, or lying down too? Does it wake you at night?

lines.zh: 站著踩下去最痛，像要裂開。躺著還好。
lines.en: Worst when I put my weight on it, like it is splitting. Lying down is all right.

lines.zh: 承重會痛。去 PACS，先看那根骨頭，再決定她今天能不能照。
lines.en: Pain on weight-bearing. Go to PACS, look at the bone first, then decide whether she is treated today.

guide.zh: 到 PACS 看右大腿骨
guide.en: Look at the right femur on PACS

lines.zh: 核對姓名、出生日期、檢查日期。然後不要先找痛的地方，先找會斷的地方。
lines.en: Name, date of birth, study date. Then do not look for where it hurts; look for where it will break.

question.zh: 大腿骨轉移的影像，在決定放療之前要看哪三件事？
question.en: On the image of a femoral metastasis, which three things must be assessed before any radiotherapy is decided?

answer.zh: 一、位置：在近端（股骨頸、轉子）風險最高。二、骨皮質被破壞的範圍：越長、越深，越容易斷。三、病灶的性質與大小：溶骨性、佔了骨頭直徑一大半的，是高風險。加上「承重會痛」，就要先轉骨科評估預防性固定。
answer.en: One, location: the proximal femur, neck and trochanter, carries the highest risk. Two, cortical destruction: the longer and deeper, the likelier the break. Three, the lesion's nature and size: lytic and occupying much of the bone's diameter is high risk. Add 'pain on weight-bearing' and orthopaedics must assess prophylactic fixation first.

post.zh: 近端、溶骨性、骨皮質被吃掉一大段。師傅看著你。
post.en: Proximal, lytic, a long stretch of cortex gone. The mentor is looking at you.

guide.zh: 告訴吳阿姨今天的決定

lines.zh: 醫師，可以照了嗎？我下午要回去顧店。
lines.en: Doctor, can we do it now? I have to get back to the shop this afternoon.

q.zh: 高風險的大腿骨病灶，承重會痛，病人想今天照完回家。你怎麼做？
q.en: A high-risk femoral lesion, painful on weight-bearing, and a patient who wants to be treated and go home today. What do you do?

options.zh: 先不承重、拐杖，今天轉骨科評估固定，放療配合安排
options.en: No weight-bearing, crutches, orthopaedics today for fixation, radiotherapy scheduled around it

why.zh: 放療止痛要幾週才生效，而骨頭隨時可能斷。先撐住骨頭，再照，兩科一起排。她會失望，但她還走得進禮堂。
why.en: Radiotherapy takes weeks to relieve pain, and the bone could break at any moment. Prop the bone up, then irradiate, both teams scheduling together. She will be disappointed, but she will still walk into the hall.

options.zh: 今天單次照射，止痛快，之後再說
options.en: Single fraction today, quick relief, review later

why.zh: 單次照射是好工具，但它不會讓被吃掉的骨皮質長回來。照完回家，踩一下樓梯，就是病理性骨折。
why.en: A single fraction is a fine tool, but it does not regrow the cortex. Treated and sent home, one step on the stairs is a pathological fracture.

options.zh: 加強止痛，請她正常走路，兩週後回診
options.en: Stronger analgesia, walk normally, review in two weeks

why.zh: 止痛會讓她更敢踩，骨頭更快斷。痛是警報器，拆掉警報器不等於滅火。
why.en: Better analgesia makes her put more weight through it, and the bone breaks sooner. Pain is the alarm; silencing it is not putting out the fire.

post.zh: （拿出一張手繪骨頭圖）吳阿姨，這是您的大腿骨。這一塊要先撐住，再照。畢業典禮我們一起想辦法。
post.en: (Producing a drawing) Mrs Wu, this is your femur. This part gets propped up first, then treated. The graduation we will work out together.

note.zh: 骨科接手吳阿姨，病灶量好
note.en: Orthopaedics takes Mrs Wu; lesion measured

sub.en: He has seen Mrs Wu's images

lines.zh: 阿豪。吳阿姨的片子我看了，近端、皮質吃一大段，同意先預防性固定。你們放療排在術後。她現在用拐杖了嗎？
lines.en: Hao. I have seen Mrs Wu's images: proximal, a long stretch of cortex gone, agreed, prophylactic fixation first. Your radiotherapy after surgery. Is she on crutches yet?

lines.zh: 已經拿拐杖、先不承重，轉診單寫好了。放療我們排在術後傷口穩定之後，兩科一起追蹤。
lines.en: Crutches and non-weight-bearing already, referral written. Radiotherapy scheduled once the wound is settled, joint follow-up.

lines.zh: 好。對了，畢業典禮那件事，她也跟我講了。
lines.en: Good. And yes, she told me about the graduation too.

guide.en: Measure the lesion's long and short axes

lines.zh: 轉診單要附病灶大小。長軸、垂直的短軸，同一個切面，寫下切面編號。以後比較才有基準。
lines.en: The referral needs the lesion size. Long axis, perpendicular short axis, same slice, slice number recorded. That is the baseline for every later comparison.

post.zh: 可以。記得，量的是病灶，不是痛。
post.en: Good. Remember, you measured the lesion, not the pain.

note.zh: 賴先生的再照射：兩次加總
note.en: Mr Lai's re-irradiation: two courses summed

guide.zh: 跟阿倫看賴先生的 DVH
guide.en: Review Mr Lai's DVH with Lun

lines.zh: 賴先生兩年前的計畫我融合進來了。兩張劑量體積直方圖：一張只有新計畫，一張是兩次加總。你先看哪一張？
lines.en: I have fused Mr Lai's plan from two years ago. Two dose–volume histograms: the new plan alone, and the two courses summed. Which do you read first?

lines.zh: 先別急著回答。靶區和器官要一起看，不是先把靶區畫滿再想辦法。
lines.en: Do not answer yet. Target and organs are read together, not target first and rescue later.

post.zh: 對。加總那張，脊髓的曲線已經貼近器官耐受劑量。所以靶區那一側要讓，不是脊髓讓。組織會記得。
post.en: Right. On the summed plot the cord curve already sits near organ tolerance. So the target yields on that side, not the cord. Tissue remembers.

guide.zh: 勾畫胸椎的臨床靶體積
guide.en: Contour the thoracic clinical target volume

lines.zh: 輪到你畫臨床靶體積。椎體一節，往脊髓那一側要收。畫完我們看它和舊照野疊多少。
lines.en: Your turn to contour the clinical target volume. One vertebral body, pulled in on the cord side. Then we look at how much it overlaps the old field.

post.zh: 可以。接下來柳物理師會用她的方法再算一次脊髓的加總。
post.en: Good. Next, Dr Liu recalculates the cord sum by her own method.

guide.zh: 問柳物理師 DVH 沒說的事
guide.en: Ask Dr Liu what the DVH does not say

lines.zh: 兩張 DVH 都在耐受以內，可以放心了嗎？DVH 有一件事永遠不告訴你。
lines.en: Both DVHs are within tolerance; can we relax? There is one thing a DVH never tells you.

post.zh: 對，位置。熱點落在脊髓的哪一節，要回影像一層一層看。這次熱點和舊照野在同一節，所以我們再讓一點。
post.en: Yes, location. Which level of the cord the hot spot falls on is found only by going back through the images slice by slice. This time it sits at the same level as the old field, so we yield a little more.

note.zh: 賴先生：講清楚再照射與閃燃
note.en: Mr Lai: re-irradiation and flare explained

guide.en: Explain the plan to Mr Lai

lines.zh: 醫師，以前照過，再照會不會怎樣？我聽說照太多會癱。
lines.en: Doctor, it has been irradiated before; what happens if you do it again? I heard too much can paralyse you.

lines.zh: 賴先生，您問到重點。脊髓記得以前的劑量，所以我們把兩次加在一起算，讓靶區在脊髓那一側退一點，留餘地給它。
lines.en: Mr Lai, that is exactly the point. The spinal cord remembers its earlier dose, so we add the two courses together and pull the target back on the cord side to leave it a margin.

lines.zh: 還有一件事要先講：照完頭幾天，痛可能先變厲害。
lines.en: And one more thing to say before we start: in the first days after treatment the pain may get worse first.

lines.zh: 對，叫疼痛暫時加劇，常見、會過去，止痛依醫囑備好。但如果出現腿無力、麻、大小便改變，那不是閃燃，要立刻回來。
lines.en: Yes, a pain flare: common and temporary, with analgesia ready per orders. But new leg weakness, numbness or any bladder or bowel change is not a flare; come back at once.

lines.zh: 痛會先變厲害……好，先講我就不怕。電話留給我。
lines.en: Worse first... all right, now that I know, I am not afraid. Leave me the number.

guide.zh: 把計畫送獨立檢核並記錄
guide.en: Send the plan for independent check and record it

lines.zh: 你把兩張 DVH、加總的脊髓曲線、熱點所在的切面編號、讓步的理由，一起附在計畫上送檢核。理由寫清楚，三年後的人才看得懂。
lines.en: You attach both DVHs, the summed cord curve, the slice number of the hot spot and the reason for the compromise, and send the plan for checking. Write the reason clearly; someone three years from now must understand it.

note.en: Yu febrile: not sleeping it off

guide.en: Take the call; receive Yu in clinic

sub.en: Yu says she is cold after treatment, shivering

lines.zh: 小敏。小玉今天躺上治療床就在抖，照完說冷，想回家睡。她這週白血球很低，我把她帶去診間了。
lines.en: Min. Yu was shivering on the couch today and wants to go home to sleep. Her white cells are very low this week. I have brought her to the clinic.

lines.zh: 醫師，我只是有點冷，嘴巴破吃不下才沒力。回家睡一覺就好。
lines.en: Doctor, I am just a little cold. My mouth is sore and I cannot eat, that is why I am weak. I will sleep it off at home.

lines.zh: 監視器上的體溫在往上跳。她裹著外套，牙齒在打顫。
lines.en: The temperature on the monitor is climbing. She is wrapped in her coat and her teeth are chattering.

options.zh: 培養、一小時內依規範抗生素、通知師傅與急診
options.en: Cultures, antibiotics within the hour per protocol, inform the mentor and the ER

why.zh: 同步化放療第四週、白血球低、發燒發抖，是發燒性嗜中性球低下。培養在抗生素之前，抗生素在一小時內，然後交給急診與腫瘤團隊。
why.en: Week four of chemoradiation, low white cells, fever and rigors: febrile neutropenia. Cultures before the antibiotic, antibiotic within the hour, then the ER and oncology team take over.

options.zh: 開退燒藥，回家觀察，明天再看
options.en: Antipyretic, home to observe, review tomorrow

why.zh: 沒有兵的身體裡，一個晚上就夠變成敗血症。她不能回家。
why.en: In a body with no defenders, one night is enough to become sepsis. She does not go home.

options.zh: 應該是黏膜炎的發炎反應，先補水
options.en: Probably inflammation from the mucositis; fluids first

why.zh: 黏膜炎正是細菌進血液的門。白血球低的時候，每一次發燒都當感染，直到證明不是。
why.en: Mucositis is precisely the door through which bacteria enter the blood. With low white cells, every fever is infection until proven otherwise.

post.zh: 急診那邊已經知道了。小玉，今晚不回家。放療會暫停一兩天，我們記下來，之後補。
post.en: The ER knows. Yu, you are not going home tonight. Radiotherapy pauses a day or two; we record it and make it up afterwards.

lines.zh: 骨科剛來訊息：吳阿姨後天開刀做預防性固定，術後放療我們已經預排。她帶著拐杖和那張骨頭圖回家的。
lines.en: Orthopaedics just messaged: Mrs Wu has prophylactic fixation the day after tomorrow, and post-operative radiotherapy is pencilled in. She went home with crutches and the bone drawing.

lines.zh: 先問會不會斷。她今天沒照到，但下週她會走進禮堂，用拐杖也是走。
lines.en: Ask if it will break first. She was not treated today, but next week she walks into the hall, crutches and all.

lines.zh: 急診剛來電：吳阿姨下午回店裡搬東西，右大腿一聲就斷了，病理性骨折，骨科今晚開刀。她問：「不是照過了嗎？」
lines.en: The ER just phoned: Mrs Wu went back to the shop this afternoon, lifted a box, and the right femur went. Pathological fracture; orthopaedics operates tonight. She asked, 'But wasn't it treated?'

lines.zh: 放療止痛，止不了斷。這一課用她的大腿骨上的。明天你去病房看她，親自解釋。
lines.en: Radiotherapy relieves pain; it does not prevent breaks. That lesson cost her femur. Tomorrow you go to the ward and explain it yourself.

guide.en: Check the plan status with Lun

lines.zh: 賴先生的計畫檢核過了，脊髓加總在耐受內，熱點切面有記錄。明天模擬定位的姿勢要和兩年前一樣，我把舊照片印出來了。
lines.en: Mr Lai's plan passed the check, cord sum within tolerance, hot-spot slice recorded. Tomorrow's simulation must match the position from two years ago; I have printed the old set-up photos.

lines.zh: 今天三個病人，三個都想要「快一點」：快照、快止痛、快回家。
lines.en: Three patients today, all wanting 'quicker': quicker treatment, quicker relief, quicker home.

lines.zh: 我們做的是把順序擺對：先問會不會斷、先找舊劑量、先把發燒當急症。緩和不是隨便，緩和是更小心。
lines.en: What we did was put things in order: ask about the break first, find the old dose first, treat the fever as an emergency first. Palliative does not mean casual; it means more careful.

lines.zh: 師傅，骨頭圖還有嗎？
lines.en: Dr Chien, any bone drawings left?

lines.zh: 抽屜裡一疊。你明天自己畫一張試試。
lines.en: A drawer full. Tomorrow you draw one yourself.

sub.zh: 第一次照完，今晚比昨天更痛
sub.en: First treatment done; tonight hurts more than yesterday

lines.zh: 醫師，不好意思這麼晚。今天照了第一次，現在比昨天還痛。是不是惡化了？是不是你們照壞了？
lines.en: Doctor, sorry it is so late. First treatment today, and tonight it hurts more than yesterday. Is it getting worse? Did the treatment damage something?

lines.zh: 賴先生，先回答我三個問題：腿有沒有無力？有沒有麻？大小便有沒有改變？
lines.en: Mr Lai, three questions first: any weakness in the legs? Any numbness? Any change in passing urine or stool?

lines.zh: 都沒有，就是痛，跟原來一樣的位置。
lines.en: None of those. Just pain, in the same place as before.

lines.zh: 那就是下午講的疼痛暫時加劇，常見、會過去。止痛依醫囑用，明天我打給您。三個問題只要有一個變成「有」，立刻來急診。
lines.en: Then it is the pain flare we talked about this afternoon: common, and it passes. Analgesia per orders, and I will phone you tomorrow. If any of those three answers ever becomes 'yes', come to the ER at once.

lines.zh: 先講我就不怕。晚安，醫師。
lines.en: Now that I know, I am not afraid. Good night, doctor.

sub.zh: 先問會不會斷；組織會記得劑量
sub.en: Ask if it will break first; tissue remembers its dose
